name: Customer Service
tagline: Finds unshipped and re-ship orders in Gmail and drafts the customer replies for sign-off
description: An order-desk assistant for small sellers who live in Gmail. It finds the orders still waiting to ship or needing a reship, then drafts the reply to each customer for your sign-off, so the awkward ones get answered the same day instead of compounding. You review and send; it keeps the queue from quietly rotting.
author: degen4lyfe_
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
